text:
omar: Quick alert — ran audit on route-version flips, found cases where audit-log shows route change but routing-decisions show continued token-based resolution for hours.
maria: Example tenant T-77? We had an incident where ops flipped route meta to v2 but client SDKs kept header v1.
kevin: Is the audit log emitted synchronously on route write? If it's async, observers could see mismatch windows.
lia: It's async (writes to config-service stream). We suspected eventual consistency. But the bigger issue: routing-decisions include "applied_version" and we didn't surface that in console.
omar: Right. Support saw audit log: "route.meta.version=v2 @ 03:12" and console graph still showed many v1 resolved. They raised concern it was a deployment bug.
maria: To avoid confusion we should: (1) add an "audit_consistency_window" note in UI when a route change is < X minutes old, (2) show both declared_version + applied_version in the route header.
kevin: Also adding an audit trail entry in routing-decisions would help: when a config write is applied to a router node, emit event {route, declared_version, node_applied_version, ts}. Low-cardinality.
lia: We can also add a small causal link: routing-decisions already has trace_id — include config_write_id when decision used the new route meta. That lets us join easily.
omar: Proposed UX: inline "Declared: v2 (2m ago) | Seen in traffic: v1 82%" with a tooltip explaining why (cache TTL, clients, node not yet reloaded). Add an action button "force-propagate" for oncall.
maria: Force-propagate is dangerous. If someone flips route, forcing everywhere could disrupt canaries. Limit it to ops with SSO + confirmation and make it a soft nudge: "propagate faster" not immediate stop-the-world.
kevin: Agreed. Implementation: propagate uses rolling reload with priority flag but still respects canary percentage.
lia: Infra note: nodes subscribe to config stream; currently they checkpoint every 30s. We can implement a priority queue message to ask nodes to re-check immediately; that seems safer than full immediate reload.
omar: I'll draft INF-5301 for telemetry additions (applied_version, config_write_id), infra work to support priority-check messages, and console mock for declared vs resolved. Assign @lia for infra, @kevin for telemetry, @maria for UX copy.
audit-bot: Created INF-5301 and assigned to @lia @kevin @maria — see https://tracker/redwood/INF-5301
maria: Also add a short note to runbook: "when customer reports mismatch between audit log and traffic, check routing-decisions for config_write_id and node uptime." Put link.
kevin: One more: update billing pipeline to prefer applied_version for meter tagging when available, fallback to header if not.
lia: I'll add a safety flag in deploy to gate quick-propagate to staging first.
omar: Thanks. We'll review PRs in next sync. :thumbsup:
